text: Both Bitcoin and Ethereum are down roughly 4% over the past day, signaling modest profit-taking despite the Fear & Greed index remaining in greed territory at 68. Bitcoin's dominance holding steady above 59% alongside $82B in daily volume suggests conviction among larger holders, even as altcoins face slightly sharper pressure. The 15-point rise in sentiment over a week indicates the market has absorbed this pullback as normal correction rather than panic.
